one_line: A child's delighted face at 0:00, then real photos held beside the illustrated pages; copy the open, not the length.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 a girl (about 5 to 6) on a sofa, mouth wide open, an adult hand holding out a book. Headline from 0:00: "POV: נכנסת לתוך הספר ✨". From 0:01 illustrated girls fill the lower half; "תקריאי לי" at 0:03.
q1_hook.why: A child's open-mouthed delight is on screen from frame one (K8, H1), with a POV headline that promises something to see (T3, H5). Illustrated versions of her appear by 0:01 (H2). The product is not named until 0:12, and the headline starts near the top 14% line (H2, T4).

beats.what: Excited girl on a sofa takes a book; illustrated girls in the lower half; "תקריאי לי"
beats.why: A reaction first, with the result beside it

beats.what: Illustrated girl at a castle with a rainbow, then a real photo beside an illustrated one
Mother reads on the sofa; headline "רוצים גם?", "עם Mebook.ai זה אפשרי ובקלות"
beats.why: Names the product and the promise

beats.what: Headline steps: "מכניסים תמונה של הילד/ה", "שם וגיל", "אפשר גם לערוך"; a dance-scene photo pair at 0:31
beats.why: The ordering steps in four lines of text

beats.what: "תעניקו להם תחושת מסוגלות", "יכולת התמודדות"; the girl holds a page to the lens at 0:45
Pink bedroom reading, forest inset; back on the sofa, a jacket photo pair at 1:04; "תהנו!!!"
beats.why: A second setting and another pair

beats.what: Read-aloud of the book's story, sofa and pink wall alternating; insets of a cat in a tree, chicks
beats.why: The story, not the product, for 40 s

beats.what: Sofa reading; rain scene; a rabbit-field pair at 1:57; pink room again, subtitle mid-sentence
beats.why: A last pair, then it stops without a close

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None. No question, tip or ask to comment, share or save in the video; the caption has only a code line.
q2_flow.why: Text steps over a changing face and insets pack the product into the first 36 s (R3, E2). Photo-and-illustration pairs recur at 0:08, 0:31, 1:04 and 1:57 (S2). After about 1:08 it is read-aloud of the book's plot, adding nothing new about the product (R1, R2).

q3_cta.what: None in the video: the last text is "תהנו!!!" at 1:05, not an ask. Caption line 2: "שימו לב יש 10% הנחה! עם הקוד TALLY10". No comment word, no link, no question.
q3_cta.why: One ask, a code with a real discount (C1, C2), but only in the caption. The video neither says nor shows it, and it stops mid-reading with no end card, so a viewer persuaded at 0:36 has no next step on screen (C6).

q4_shown.what: A mother and a girl about 5 to 6 reading the printed book on a sofa and in a pink bedroom; split screens of real photos beside illustrated versions at 0:08, 0:31, 1:04 and 1:57; pages held to the lens. No price, no screen recording.
q4_shown.why: A real photo beside the illustrated character, held about 3 s at 0:31, is the likeness proof a buyer needs (S2). The steps are only text, but the child's delight is the payoff (S8). A child's full face for two minutes is what LumeBook's own Reels avoid (S5).

q5_edit.what: 39 detected shots in 125 s, about 3.2 s each, many of them split-screen changes. Two settings alternate: sofa and pink wall. Hard cuts, inset pictures, no speed changes seen. Two text layers. Ends mid-sentence.
q5_edit.why: A change every 2 to 4 s inside two scenes is a moderate pace (E2), and the insets add fresh pictures (R3). Two text layers plus split screens crowd the frame (T2). At 125 s it is long for the message, and it ends with no close (R2, E8).

q6_topic.what: A mother and daughter read a personalised book starring the girl; text explains how to order and why it builds confidence, with a 10% code.
q6_topic.why: A child delighted to see herself is a high-arousal positive moment (K1, K8). The promises, "תחושת מסוגלות", "יכולת התמודדות", "הקניית ערכים", answer a parent concern but are stated flatly, with nothing to check (K6, K4).

q7_filmed.what: Eye-level medium shots, mostly steady, of a mother and a girl on a grey sofa before a kitchen, and in a dim pink bedroom in warm light; both hold pages up to the lens at times.
q7_filmed.why: A real home and a real family read as native (H8, F7). Both mostly look at the book, not the lens (F6). Faces fill the frame and carry the feeling (K8).

q8_text.on_screen: White bold headline, 1 to 3 lines, from about 15% down: "POV: נכנסת לתוך הספר ✨" (0:00), "רוצים גם?" (0:11), "עם Mebook.ai זה אפשרי ובקלות" (0:12), "מכניסים תמונה של הילד/ה" (0:18), "שם וגיל" (0:21), "אפשר גם לערוך, לשנות ולהוסיף מה שרוצים!" (0:31), "תעניקו להם תחושת מסוגלות" (0:38), "תהנו!!!" (1:05). Beige subtitles of the reading, about 60% down.
q8_text.caption: "כשפתאום נכנסת לתוך הספר✨🥹🥳". Three short lines, about 15 words: the hook, "שימו לב יש 10% הנחה! עם הקוד TALLY10", then "בשיתוף @mebook.ai". No question, no hashtags.
q8_text.why: A headline from 0:00 naming the product by 0:12 works muted (T3, T1). Subtitles sit inside the safe zone (T4), but two layers over split screens crowd the frame (T2), and "POV:" starts a line in Latin (T6). The caption has no product words or hashtags (T7); the partnership is on its last line (T8).

weak_points: 125 s for one message; the book's plot read aloud after 1:08; two text layers over split screens; no CTA in the video; the child's full face for two minutes; it stops mid-sentence.
lumebook_takeaway: Film a hand holding out the book with a POV line, hold the source photo beside the illustrated page for 3 s, and stop by 30 s.
not_verified: Spoken words: the machine transcript is garbled, so only burned-in text is quoted.
